name: Pill Navbar
summary: A floating pill-shaped top bar with a stroke-drawn logo, hover-wash nav items and multi-column mega dropdowns that collapses into a Menu/Close panel on narrow screens.
useWhen: A marketing site wants a floating, rounded header with rich product dropdowns
Dropdowns need grouped columns of icon, title and description links with hover intent and arrow-key navigation
avoidWhen: A full-width classic top bar fits better; use marketing/product-navbar
An app shell needs persistent navigation; use a sidebar from app-interface
